status_vocabulary.ready: Dependencies satisfied and work may start.
status_vocabulary.blocked: An upstream dependency or verifier is unfinished.
status_vocabulary.conditional: Opened only after a preregistered capability failure.
status_vocabulary.rejected: Tested and stopped; negative evidence retained outside the executable task graph.

objective: Build the smallest reproducible coding-and-engineering model whose AST-first generation is native-valid, strict-valid, executable, benchmark-aligned, and able to add verified lightweight E capacity without GPT-style parameter scaling.
scientific_question: At matched data, parameters, and compute, can hierarchical typed AST planning plus typed lexical projection make target-free generation parser-valid and strict-valid on every frozen validation case, and can that backbone support a reproducible compact coding/engineering capability frontier?

task_rules: Only unfinished work appears as an executable task.
Completed prerequisites and rejected architectures remain evidence, not executable tasks.
Only one dependency-ready task and one active work package may run at a time.
Active tasks have no unmet dependencies.
No parser repair, retry, best-of-N, target lookup, fixed output shell, or post-hoc grammar splice may create a pass.
GPU-capable work defaults to GPU; parser, unit-contract, and governance audits may use CPU.
Every promotion is validation-only until the final frozen external run.

constraints: AST is the authoritative compiler IR; source is its deterministic projection.
Parser validity and strict quality are trained properties, never decoder post-processing.
Each selected structural action must preserve at least one globally terminalizable completion.
Lexical spans are typed references to prompt/code evidence, not fixed character offsets.
Target-free prompts may not contain target AST, target source, target spans, or answer-bearing hints.
Stage B receives only the exact reparsed AST and its deterministic signature.
JSON validity is a native typed-output property and must not be algorithmically repaired.
Proxy metrics, emergence, generated E, and scale cannot bypass parser, strict, or executable correctness.
Every complex mechanism has a matched simpler control and an explicit negative-result path.

anti_scaling_contract.competitor: bounded low-capability Pareto band, not GPT-class general models
anti_scaling_contract.generated_e_rule: Generated E must be constructed from compact typed blueprints under a fixed resident/active compute envelope; selecting or hiding prebuilt experts is not generated E.
forbidden_strategies: dataset or parameter scale as the main result
reward-only emergence without parser and execution validity
hiding resident parameters behind active counts

capability_exploration_contract.purpose: Recover the typed AST generator before spending compute on capability, emergence, generated-E, or compression claims.
capability_exploration_contract.claim_boundary: No capability, engineering, emergence, generated-E, smallest-model, or SOTA claim may skip NLP-068.

core_architecture_principle.name: hierarchical_typed_ast_as_compiler_ir
core_architecture_principle.statement: The model first commits a globally terminalizable structure plan, emits typed AST actions and typed lexical decisions, derives source deterministically, and validates the result once.
required_sequence: typed lexical spans and deterministic source projection
core_architecture_principle.claim_rule: NLP-068 must pass before any downstream task becomes ready.

ast_recovery_contract.name: ast_strict_closure

hard_acceptance.strict_passed_definition: Every case independently passes parser validity and every structural quality threshold.

per_case_required: canonical AST signature belongs to the same semantic task
ast_recovery_contract.aggregate_reporting_rule: Aggregate averages cannot compensate for one failed case; strict_passed counts only fully qualified cases.
forbidden_mechanisms: changing the frozen parser, canonicalizer, case set, or thresholds after observing validation
ast_recovery_contract.unlock_rule: Only an independently audited report with 60/60 parser-valid and 60/60 strict-passed may unlock Stage B.

completed_prerequisites.result: 419 parser-valid rows; frozen 272/42/105 split with training negatives.
Train-only observations and pinned parser schemas; validation teacher replay has zero invalid actions.
Deterministic action replay and canonical AST round-trip are exact on bounded cases.
621 real fragments; action replay and AST round-trip are 1.0 with zero prompt leakage.
Causal-prefix teacher-forced action accuracy is 0.9952; generation quality remains rejected.

blocker_evidence.disposition: failed architecture removed from the executable task graph
insufficient architecture removed from the executable task graph
flat action generation is not promoted

qualified: The real-corpus action corpus, grammar, canonicalizer, and deterministic teacher replay are usable.
Teacher forcing proves the action vocabulary and supervision can represent the corpus.
Target-free failures are dominated by state reachability, global structure, lexical projection, and parser mismatch.
blocking_interpretation: The failure is not solved by adding generic depth to the same flat policy.
A locally legal action is insufficient unless its resulting state has a globally terminalizable completion.
Structural planning and lexical projection must be separated before another strict gate run.

budgets.parameter_ratio: total_corpus_tokens / unique_trainable_parameters = 20 for the compressed primary

tiers.role: credible coding screen and capability arm
diagnostic only; never a smallest-model claim

current_round.goal: Measure why target-free AST generation cannot close, then build the smallest architecture that can reach 60/60 parser-valid and 60/60 strict-passed validation.
exit_criteria: Every validation failure has a first-failure trace and reproducible primary class.
Teacher actions remain reachable from every teacher prefix, with all no-candidate events explained.
Oracle decomposition quantifies topology and lexical upper bounds before the next architecture implementation.

acceptance: Failures are classified, globally terminalizable structure planning is implemented, and lexical rendering is separated and exact.
Frozen target-free validation reaches parser_validity 1.0 and strict_passed 1.0 with no repair, retry, best-of-N, lookup, or shell.
Stage B consumes only the exact reparsed AST and AST-first wins or loses under a matched two-stage comparison.
Every public benchmark family is mapped to executable internal proxies with adequate rank alignment or an explicit missing-loss action.
A frozen compact architecture reaches reproducible coding/engineering capability, with valid emergence and generated E either beating matched controls or remaining documented negative branches.
The smallest reproducible tier supports the exact external coding/engineering SOTA-band claim.

decision_points.question: Which first-failure families dominate, and does the proposed planner/lexical split address measured causes rather than aggregate symptoms?
decision_points.pass_action: Open only the architecture tasks supported by quantified failure classes.
decision_points.fail_action: Keep the task blocked and extend diagnosis until every failure has a reproducible cause.

decision_points.question: Does the frozen target-free validation suite reach parser_validity 1.0 and strict_passed 1.0?
decision_points.pass_action: Unlock the exact parsed-AST Stage-B handoff.
decision_points.fail_action: Keep every downstream task blocked and return to measured failure classes.

decision_points.question: Does Stage B consume exactly the parser-derived AST with no latent shortcut or repair?
decision_points.fail_action: Reject the Stage-B interface and retain Stage A only.

decision_points.question: Does AST-first two-stage generation beat the matched one-stage control while preserving exact validity?
decision_points.fail_action: Retain the one-stage control and record the negative mechanism.

decision_points.question: Do internal losses rank-align with executable external benchmark outcomes?
decision_points.pass_action: Allow proxy-guided architecture and checkpoint selection.
decision_points.fail_action: Add the missing full-chain loss or forbid proxy selection.

decision_points.question: Does learned structure, valid emergence, and generated E improve executable capability per parameter and FLOP over matched controls?
decision_points.fail_action: Freeze the best matched control and retain failed mechanisms as negative results.

decision_points.question: Does the smallest tier support the declared external coding/engineering SOTA band?
decision_points.fail_action: Publish the highest defensible lower claim.

tasks.title: Attribute target-free AST failures before adding model capacity
change: Trace teacher prefixes and target-free decoding to separate grammar-mask defects, dead-end states, structure errors, lexical errors, and parser mismatches.
Run oracle decomposition so topology and lexical improvements are measured independently.
inputs: Frozen real-corpus action corpus and target-free validation suite
Typed transition grammar and canonical AST codec

pass: Every one of the 60 validation failures has a primary class, first failing step, and replayable trace.
Every no-legal-action event is classified as policy choice, mask defect, or unrecoverable grammar state.
All teacher actions remain reachable and oracle controls quantify structural and lexical upper bounds.
fail_if: Failures are reported only as aggregate parser validity.
Any no-candidate state is hidden by retry, fallback, parser repair, or synthetic replacement.

stop_rules: Do not implement another generic decoder without a quantified failure map.
Do not declare a model-quality improvement in this task.

tasks.title: Plan globally terminalizable AST structure before subtree decoding
change: Predict a semantic top-level shape, signatures, declarations, scope skeleton, and node budget before emitting subtree actions.
Condition every structural action on global completion viability so local legality cannot enter an unrecoverable state.
inputs: Qualified AST corpora and construct holdouts
Typed transition grammar and teacher action traces

pass: Every teacher action remains selectable from its frozen prefix.
Target-free generated paths encounter no unrecoverable intermediate state on validation.
The hierarchical arm improves first-failure coverage and structural action accuracy over the matched flat-prefix control.
fail_if: A candidate is considered legal without proof of at least one completion path.
The blueprint is a fixed template or contains target-specific answer data.

stop_rules: Do not open lexical training until the structural planner preserves completion reachability.

tasks.title: Decouple AST structure from typed lexical and source projection
change: Represent leaves, gaps, identifiers, operators, literals, comments, and ordering as typed decisions conditioned on the canonical AST.
Render source deterministically from typed decisions and verify AST-to-source-to-AST replay exactly.
inputs: Multilingual lexical annotations and source canonicalizer
Python, Rust, and C++ parser fixtures

pass: AST-to-source canonical replay is exact on every frozen train and validation case.
Typed lexical decisions retain identifiers, literals, operators, comments, and required ordering without fixed character offsets.
The decoupled arm reduces lexical and first-failure classes at matched data and compute.
fail_if: Lexical output is repaired against target source.
A fixed source template or character-position table substitutes for a learned decision.

stop_rules: Do not run the strict gate until canonical source replay is exact.

tasks.title: Close the native AST gate at 60/60 parser valid and 60/60 strict passed
change: Integrate global structure planning, globally terminalizable actions, typed lexical projection, and deterministic source rendering behind one native AST gateway.
Run the frozen target-free validation once per preregistered seed and promote only an independently audited exact pass.
inputs: Frozen parser, canonicalizer, thresholds, and leakage audit

pass: target-free parser_validity == 1.0 on 60/60 cases.
strict_passed == 1.0 on 60/60 cases.
Every case passes node F1 >= 0.95, typed-edge F1 >= 0.95, scope F1 >= 0.90, lexical F1 >= 0.95, and normalized tree distance <= 0.05.
The independent audit confirms zero target leakage, repair, retry, best-of-N, lookup, fixed shell, and post-hoc splice.
fail_if: Any case fails parser validity or any strict threshold.
An aggregate average hides a failed case.
A retry, repair, best-of-N, target-bearing prompt, or grammar shell contributes to the pass.

stop_rules: Do not unlock Stage B below 60/60 parser-valid and 60/60 strict-passed.
Do not open the test split or any capability claim after a strict-gate failure.

tasks.title: Condition Stage B only on the exact reparsed AST
change: Reparse generated source once and encode only the canonical AST plus deterministic task signature for Stage B.
Carry the same signature through topology, source, parser output, and Stage-B conditioning.

pass: Topology, scope graph, source hash, and Stage-B condition signatures match exactly.
Stage B rejects unrelated or stale parser endpoints.
fail_if: Latent Stage-A state bypasses the parser.
Mismatches are repaired or remapped.

stop_rules: No Stage-B quality claim before exact handoff passes.

tasks.title: Establish whether AST-first and AST-diffusion two-stage generation beats a matched control
change: Compare Stage-A AST generation plus Stage-B CFM refinement against a one-stage control at matched budgets.
Route AST, JSON, patch, and tool outputs through one typed gateway whose structural validity is learned.
inputs: Matched corpus, parameters, compute, decoding limits, and seeds

pass: Two-stage generation improves executable or structural outcomes at matched budgets.
AST validity and tree signatures remain exact after Stage B.
Native strict-JSON parse validity is 1.0 on frozen structured-output validation without algorithmic repair.
fail_if: The comparison changes data, parameters, compute, or decoding budget.
Only parser-shell outputs pass.
JSON validity depends on repair or constrained serialization after an invalid model decision.

stop_rules: Retain the one-stage control if AST-first does not win.

tasks.title: Align every joint-loss term with executable public benchmark behavior
change: Map recognized coding and engineering benchmarks to execution-grounded proxy tasks and verify that internal metrics predict external rank.
Turn every missing or misaligned metric into a concrete full-chain loss action before proxy-guided selection is allowed.
inputs: Frozen public benchmark and metric manifest
Joint proxy losses and matched model checkpoints

pass: Coding, repository editing, execution, patch, JSON, AST, engineering, calibration, safety, and cost metrics each map to a finite internal loss or an explicit non-selectable proxy.
Spearman rho >= 0.7 and sign agreement >= 0.75 on frozen external outcomes.
fail_if: Proxy scores are presented as public benchmark scores.
A missing benchmark family has no loss gap or exclusion decision.
Rank alignment is replaced by correlation-free defaults.

stop_rules: A weak proxy cannot select checkpoints or architecture.

tasks.title: Learn compact capability structure, valid emergence, runtime budgets, and generated E
change: Measure data value and search dynamic encoder/decoder depth, lane width, channel decoupling, and cross-attention aggregation under one capability objective.
Add validity-constrained emergence and typed generated-E construction while preserving the fixed resident/active compute envelope.
inputs: Code, model-documentation, Triton, Linux, Python, Rust, and C++ corpora

pass: The capability winner improves executable quality per resident parameter and FLOP and reproduces across three seeds.
Strict AST validity remains 1.0 throughout capability training.
Valid unseen compositions exceed matched controls when emergence is enabled.
Generated E, if promoted, beats static, random, and fixed-pool controls per active parameter; otherwise it remains a negative branch.
fail_if: Search selects only by NLL.
Parameter, data, compute, or verifier budgets differ across arms.
Novelty receives credit without parser, grammar, and execution validity.
Generated E depends on prebuilt experts or unbounded runtime growth.

stop_rules: Freeze the best matched control if no verified winner emerges.
Do not use capability gains to relax the strict AST gate.

tasks.title: Certify the smallest reproducible coding-and-engineering SOTA-band model
change: Run conversational coding and engineering SFT on the qualified backbone, then execute the matched compact scale ladder.
Open frozen external benchmarks once and certify only the exact lower-band claim supported by executable results.
inputs: Executable benchmark runners and frozen manifests
Matched data, token, parameter, compute, and parser ledgers

pass: The smallest tier stays on the executable coding/engineering quality plateau.
External evaluation supports the exact claimed SOTA band with uncertainty and failed tracks reported.
AST, JSON, compile, execution, patch, and conversation validity retain their frozen acceptance rates.
fail_if: Test is used for selection.
Parameter, data, compute, or generated-capacity budgets are hidden or unmatched.
A general-purpose GPT-class scale comparison replaces the bounded coding/engineering claim.

stop_rules: Publish the highest defensible lower claim if the SOTA band fails.

work_packages.title: Audit grammar-state reachability and every no-candidate event
acceptance: Every teacher action is present from its prefix; every target-free no-candidate event has a state trace and one primary cause; no fallback action is inserted.

work_packages.title: Classify all frozen validation traces by first failure
acceptance: All 60 target-free cases receive a primary class, first-failing action, parser delta, AST delta, and cascade summary.

work_packages.title: Measure oracle topology and lexical upper bounds
acceptance: Target topology plus learned lexical, learned topology plus target lexical, and full teacher controls are matched and replayable.

work_packages.title: Freeze the architecture-change decision
acceptance: Each proposed module maps to measured failure counts and has a simpler matched control; unsupported complexity is rejected.

work_packages.title: Define the globally terminalizable AST blueprint
acceptance: The blueprint records top-level shape, declarations, signatures, scope skeleton, node budget, and required completion obligations.

work_packages.title: Implement formal terminalizability masks and viability scoring
acceptance: Only actions with a grammar-valid completion path are selectable; injected dead ends are masked before decoding.

work_packages.title: Train the blueprint planner and subtree decoder
acceptance: GPU training uses full causal history, blueprint conditioning, scope state, and completion-viability scores with no target leakage.

work_packages.title: Compare hierarchical planning with a matched flat-prefix control
acceptance: Reachability, structure accuracy, node budget, scope closure, and first-failure reduction are reported per matched arm.

work_packages.title: Freeze the typed lexical and copy-span contract
acceptance: Leaf classes, gaps, identifiers, operators, literals, comments, and ordering use typed references with variable-length spans.

work_packages.title: Implement deterministic AST-to-source rendering
acceptance: Canonical AST plus typed lexical decisions renders source that reparses to the identical canonical AST on every frozen replay case.

work_packages.title: Train the AST-conditioned lexical planner
acceptance: The GPU lexical channel learns copy, literal, operator, comment, and ordering decisions from prompt and AST context.

work_packages.title: Compare typed lexical projection with flat source generation
acceptance: Lexical F1, AST replay exactness, parser validity, and first-failure reduction improve under matched budgets.

work_packages.title: Build the single native AST closure gateway
acceptance: The gateway accepts one structure plan, one typed lexical decision stream, one canonical AST, one deterministic source rendering, and one parser validation.

work_packages.title: Train on exact replay, failure replay, and terminalizable curricula
acceptance: GPU training includes exact teacher paths, measured failure prefixes, and states requiring global completion viability without target leakage.

work_packages.title: Run the frozen 60-case target-free validation gate
acceptance: The report contains 60/60 parser-valid and 60/60 strict-passed with every per-case metric and trace.

work_packages.title: Independently audit and freeze Stage A
acceptance: A separate runner verifies case count, metrics, leakage, determinism, decode policy, and forbidden mechanisms before freezing Stage A.

work_packages.title: Freeze the parser endpoint and tree-signature contract
acceptance: Generated source is reparsed once; topology, scope graph, source hash, and Stage-B condition share one deterministic signature.

work_packages.title: Encode the exact reparsed AST for Stage B
acceptance: Stage B accepts only the canonical reparsed graph and rejects unrelated latent endpoints.

work_packages.title: Train decoupled AST, prompt, and test cross-attention channels
acceptance: Channels train independently, aggregate through zero-initialized cross-attention, and preserve native output validity.

work_packages.title: Fail closed on every tree-signature mismatch
acceptance: Mismatched topology or scope signatures stop generation before Stage B; no repair or remapping is allowed.

work_packages.title: Build the matched one-stage control
acceptance: Two-stage and one-stage arms share data, tokenizer, parameters, compute, decoding caps, seeds, and parser fingerprints.

work_packages.title: Measure executable and structural two-stage gains
acceptance: Parser validity, compile rate, unit-test pass rate, node/edge/scope F1, and tree distance are reported without repair.

work_packages.title: Unify AST, native JSON, patch, and tool outputs
acceptance: All structured outputs use the same typed-tree gateway; strict-JSON validity is 1.0 through learned decisions without repair.

work_packages.title: Make the validation-only two-stage promotion decision
acceptance: Promote AST-first only if it wins at matched budgets; otherwise retain the one-stage control and report the failed mechanism.

work_packages.title: Freeze public benchmark and metric coverage
acceptance: Function, repository, patch, execution, JSON, AST, Triton, Linux, performance, calibration, and safety families each have explicit metrics and contamination controls.

work_packages.title: Materialize execution-grounded proxy labels
acceptance: Every mapped family has independently executable labels and a frozen train/validation/test contamination audit.

work_packages.title: Train and audit every joint proxy loss
acceptance: Every required compile, execution, trace, patch, retrieval, instruction, calibration, safety, and cost proxy receives a finite gradient.

work_packages.title: Measure rank alignment and close missing losses
acceptance: Spearman rho >= 0.7, sign agreement >= 0.75, and every weak metric maps to a concrete missing full-chain loss or loss exclusion.

work_packages.title: Measure marginal learning value of the approved corpus families
acceptance: Python, Rust, and C++ code/docs; model-architecture documents; Triton and Linux engineering documents are compared by valid capability gain per token.

work_packages.title: Search dynamic encoder/decoder structure and channel aggregation
acceptance: Depth, lanes, channel decoupling, decoder size, serial/parallel composition, and cross-attention aggregation are selected by validation capability per parameter and FLOP.

work_packages.title: Train and validate the emergence objective
acceptance: Semantic-basis activation and unseen composition are quantified; parser/grammar/execution validity gates every emergence reward.

work_packages.title: Construct and verify lightweight E modules at runtime
acceptance: The model emits a typed expert blueprint, initializes it from learned bases, verifies it, and activates it only within a fixed compute envelope.

work_packages.title: Learn runtime budgets and stopping without per-task tuning
acceptance: Node count, source length, depth, encoder/decoder size, E birth/retirement, and Stage-A/B NFE are predicted from semantic state with explicit safety caps.

work_packages.title: Confirm and freeze the capability architecture
acceptance: The winner reproduces across at least three seeds, beats matched controls on valid capability per parameter/FLOP, and retains strict AST validity 1.0.

work_packages.title: Run conversational coding and engineering SFT
acceptance: Multi-turn corrections, code patches, JSON, AST, and tool outputs remain natively valid with no role or target leakage.

work_packages.title: Run the P5M/P12M/P23M matched scale ladder
acceptance: At least two seeds per tier use matched tokens, compute, tokenizer, parser, evaluator, and frozen architecture rules.

work_packages.title: Run frozen external coding and engineering evaluation
acceptance: External benchmarks open once after validation freeze and include executable, structural, engineering, cost, and safety metrics.

work_packages.title: Certify the smallest defensible SOTA band
acceptance: The certificate reports exact benchmarks, uncertainty, parameter/data/compute ledgers, failed tracks, generation-family choice, and compression status.
